earnings.title: Teradyne Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
highlights: (NASDAQ: TER) reported revenue of $1,306 million for the third quarter of 2026 of which $1,072 million was in Semiconductor Test, $138 million in Product Test, and $96 million in Robotics.
On a GAAP-basis, net income attributable to Teradyne for the third quarter of 2026 was $342.4 million, or $2.17 per diluted share.

On a non-GAAP basis, net income attributable to Teradyne for the third quarter of 2026 was $359.9 million, or $2.29 per diluted share, which excluded acquired intangible asset amortization, restructuring and other charges, and the related tax impact on non-GAAP adjustments.

quotes.text: Our wafer to data center strategy and the breadth of our portfolio sustained positive momentum in Q3.

outlook: Revenue up 70% and earnings up over 150% from Q3'25, exceeding the high end of our Q3 Guidance

Guidance for the fourth quarter of 2026 is revenue of $1,250 million to $1,350 million, with GAAP net income attributable to Teradyne of $1.88 to $2.18 per diluted share and non-GAAP net income attributable to Teradyne of $1.95 to $2.25 per diluted share.

items.heading: Our business is impacted by global and industry-specific economic cycles, which are difficult to predict, and actions we have taken or may take to offset these cycles may not be sufficient.
The market for our products is concentrated, and our business depends, in part, on obtaining orders from a few significant customers.
Customer consolidation could affect our operating results.
If we fail to develop new technologies to adapt to our customers’ needs or if our customers fail to accept our new products, our revenues will be adversely affected.
We are subject to risks of operating internationally.

items.heading: We are subject to risks associated with doing business in China.
